History_of_Present_Illness.content: Has 5–6 loose, watery stools per day without blood
Had a couple of episodes of vomiting initially which have resolved
Feels dehydrated with decreased oral intake and poor appetite
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Feels dehydrated; ↓ oral intake; poor appetite

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Had mild warmth only early in the illness and no current fever
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: mild warmth only early on; no current fever

History_of_Present_Illness.content: No recent takeaway or restaurant meals

Family_History.source_text: FH: Father HTN, died bowel CA

Social_and_Family_History.content: Has been off work for the past 3 days

Assessment.content: Acute viral gastroenteritis with watery diarrhea and mild dehydration
Assessment.source_text: 1. Acute viral gastroenteritis w/ watery diarrhea, mild dehydration

Plan_of_Care.content: Oral rehydration solution such as Dioralyte and encourage increased oral fluids
Paracetamol as needed for fever or weakness
Rest and remain off work until diarrhea-free for 24–48 hours
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Rest; remain off work until diarrhea-free 24–48 h

Plan_of_Care.content: Return to clinic or seek care if no improvement in 3–5 days, worsening symptoms, blood in stool, persistent vomiting, or inability to maintain hydration
Plan_of_Care.source_text: RTC/seek care if no improvement in 3–5 d, worsening sx, blood in stool, persistent vomiting, or unable to maintain hydration

Follow_up_Information.content: Advised to return or seek care if no improvement in 3–5 days, worsening symptoms, blood in stool, persistent vomiting, or inability to maintain hydration
